name: Admetrics
description: The Admetrics MCP exposes Admetrics Query Language (AQL) analytics as validated tools that agents and coding assistants can call directly.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Admetrics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Admetrics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.admetrics.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Admetrics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Admetrics provides these MCP tools: compile_analytics_question, explain_analytics_query, get_client_data_freshness, list_available_clients, run_analytics_question, run_structured_analytics_query, search_analytics_catalog, and search_dimension_values.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Admetrics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Admetrics in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Admetrics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Admetrics is developed by Admetrics GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
